title: Floor-event probabilistic evaluation per weather-vintage tier

protocol.calibrator: expanding-window isotonic (increasing=False, y_min=0, y_max=1, clip); phase52::_floor_prob_and_c stage 1

inference_applicability.reason: Brier, log loss and the MAEs are means of per-observation losses, so a daily loss-differential series exists and HLN-DM applies. PR-AUC, ROC-AUC and recall-at-FPR are rank/threshold functionals with no such series; their bootstrap recomputes the functional on each resampled set of days rather than averaging daily values.
inference_applicability.log_loss_caveat: the LEVEL is eps-dependent because the isotonic map assigns exactly 0 to some slots; only DIFFERENCES are reported as findings, with an eps grid shown.

gate18_regime_claim.rule: pre-gate vs price-only d_PR-AUC, macro-average, threshold 0.5, all-hours: bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
gate18_regime_claim.if_fails: withdraw the 'predicts a regime, not only a level' framing from Section 3 and report that floor-event detection does not improve on this sample

gate19_gate_timing_in_tail.rule: post-gate vs pre-gate d_PR-AUC, macro-average, threshold 0.5: bootstrap 95% CI includes 0
gate19_gate_timing_in_tail.reading: 19a: the gate-timing null extends beyond MAE to regime detection

gate20_threshold_stability.rule: sign of the Gate-18 contrast identical across all four thresholds

gate21_midday.rule: Gate-18 contrast on the midday subset: CI lower bound > 0

gate_robustness.why: confirm the Gate 18/19 verdicts do not depend on the reduced rank-functional bootstrap

gates_reevaluated.why: the gate evaluator read only the single-point pairing names, so a capacity-weighted run left every gate unevaluated and printed passes=false; unevaluated is now recorded as such
